concept.title: How This Content Reuse Demo Maintains Itself: A Self-Referential DITA Concept

conbody.p: This topic explains how to demonstrate, update, and extend DITA content reuse, using itself as an example.

section.p: How to demonstrate reuse: This topic pulls in a safety warning from another topic using conref. To change the reused content, update the source topic.
How to demonstrate keyref usage: Region-specific instructions can be referenced using keyref (see battery_maintenance.dita for an example).
How to update: Edit the conref or keyref attributes above to point to new content as needed.
How to extend: Add new sections showing other reuse mechanisms, such as conkeyref or mapref.
